title: Job kind manifest (a description of one lab job kind)
description: A descriptive record of one job kind in the lab's kind table. The lab does not read this file: the table is compiled into the lab. The record is written from that table so that a person or an agent can read what a kind is without running the lab. See job-kind-manifest.md.

lease_class.description: `card`: takes the one shared-card lease, so one such job at a time. `cpu`: takes the separate cpu lease and never the card lease.

job_id_prefix.description: A job id starts with this word and a dash.

refusal_exit_codes.description: The exit codes this kind's own refusals own; no other kind's refusals use them.

built.description: False: the kind is in the table and the lab answers `lab_kind_not_built` to a request for it.

verbs.description: The lab verbs that take this kind (see docs/interface/commands.md).

script_name_rule.description: For a kind that runs a script: the file name the script must have.

request.description: The members of the request body, in the order the lab lists them.

environment.description: Variables the lab adds to the job's environment for this kind.

writes.description: Files the lab or the job writes for this kind.

refusal_codes.description: The refusal codes of this kind's own table, with their process exit codes. Refusals that belong to the verb for every kind are listed in docs/interface/commands.md.
